name: Elevate Campuses Limited
about: Elevate Campuses Limited owns, operates, and manages on-campus student accommodation across HEIs and own K-12 Assets in India. It offers various facilities, such as a recreational area, medical center, gymnasium, laundry room, badminton court, and cafeteria. It operates accommodation business under Good Host Spaces and ScholarZ brands. Elevate Campuses Limited was formerly known as Good Host Spaces Private Limited and changed its name to Elevate Campuses Limited in September 2025. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Mumbai, India. Elevate Campuses Limited operates as a subsidiary of Genius Bidco Holdings Pte. Ltd.
